rules.requirement: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

assertingTests.name: the Empath counts the nearest living neighbours and follows their deaths (TB-EMPATH-01)
the Empath step is built with the number shape on every night (TB-EMPATH-01)
the Empath step keeps the computed count as its record and writes one step line (TB-EMPATH-01)
a healthy Empath step stores what the host sends and journals no choice (TB-EMPATH-01)
the Empath step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-EMPATH-01)
the Empath module declares a step without a target for every night (TB-EMPATH-01)
the Empath counts the evil players among the two living neighbours (TB-EMPATH-01)

rules.requirement: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

assertingTests.name: the Empath counts the host's Spy and Recluse registration (TB-EMPATH-02)
the Empath step journals the host's registration before the step line (TB-EMPATH-02)
the Empath counts the team a neighbour registers as, not the character (TB-EMPATH-02)

rules.requirement: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

assertingTests.name: every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03)
an impaired Empath waits for the host's number and changes nothing (TB-EMPATH-03)
a Drunk shown the Empath gets the same host question and record (TB-EMPATH-03, TB-DRUNK-01)
an impaired Empath is a host choice on the command path and the answer completes it (TB-EMPATH-03)
an impaired Empath returns the same answer: the engine asks the host (TB-EMPATH-03)
the Empath names every number of fingers as a possible answer (TB-EMPATH-03)
